competencies.name: Knitting
competencies.description: Creating fabric by interlocking loops of yarn with needles for garments and accessories

competencies.name: Crochet
competencies.description: Creating fabric with a hooked needle by pulling loops through other loops

alternatives.notes: Knitting creates similar fabric using different techniques

competencies.name: Weaving
competencies.description: Interlacing threads on a loom to create fabric and textiles

competencies.name: Embroidery
competencies.description: Decorating fabric with needle and thread using decorative stitches

competencies.name: Cross-Stitch
competencies.description: Counted thread embroidery creating X-shaped stitches on even-weave fabric

competencies.name: Needlepoint
competencies.description: Canvas embroidery using diagonal tent stitches to create designs

competencies.name: Quilting
competencies.description: Sewing layers of fabric together to create quilts with decorative patterns

prerequisites.notes: Sewing skills are helpful for quilting

competencies.name: Sewing
competencies.description: Joining fabrics and materials using needle and thread or sewing machine

competencies.name: Tailoring
competencies.description: Custom fitting and constructing garments with precise measurements and techniques

prerequisites.notes: Sewing skills are essential for tailoring

competencies.name: Pattern Making
competencies.description: Creating templates and blueprints for sewing garments and textile projects

competencies.name: Spinning
competencies.description: Twisting fibers into yarn using a spinning wheel or drop spindle

competencies.name: Felting
competencies.description: Creating dense fabric by matting and pressing wool fibers together

competencies.name: Needle Felting
competencies.description: Sculpting wool fibers using barbed needles to create three-dimensional forms

competencies.name: Tapestry Weaving
competencies.description: Weaving pictorial designs and images on a loom creating decorative wall hangings

prerequisites.notes: Basic weaving skills are helpful for tapestry

competencies.name: Macramé
competencies.description: Knotting cord or string to create decorative textiles and wall hangings

competencies.name: Lace Making
competencies.description: Creating delicate openwork fabric using threads and specialized techniques

competencies.name: Tatting
competencies.description: Making lace using shuttle or needle to create knots and loops

competencies.name: Rug Hooking
competencies.description: Pulling loops of yarn or fabric through backing material to create rugs

competencies.name: Dyeing
competencies.description: Coloring fibers, yarn, and fabric using natural or synthetic dyes

competencies.name: Batik
competencies.description: Wax-resist dyeing technique creating patterns on fabric

competencies.name: Tie-Dye
competencies.description: Creating colorful patterns by tying and dyeing fabric

competencies.name: Appliqué
competencies.description: Sewing fabric pieces onto a larger background to create decorative designs

prerequisites.notes: Sewing skills are helpful for appliqué

competencies.name: Smocking
competencies.description: Decorative embroidery gathering fabric into pleated patterns

competencies.name: Beading
competencies.description: Creating jewelry and decorative items by stringing and weaving beads

competencies.name: Jewelry Making
competencies.description: Crafting wearable adornments using metals, stones, and various materials

competencies.name: Wire Wrapping
competencies.description: Creating jewelry by wrapping wire around stones and beads without soldering

competencies.name: Scrapbooking
competencies.description: Creating personalized photo albums with decorative papers and embellishments

competencies.name: Card Making
competencies.description: Creating handmade greeting cards with paper, stamps, and decorative elements

competencies.name: Bookbinding
competencies.description: Assembling and binding pages into books using traditional or modern techniques

competencies.name: Origami
competencies.description: Japanese art of paper folding to create decorative shapes and figures

competencies.name: Paper Crafts
competencies.description: Creating decorative and functional items using paper and cardstock

competencies.name: Leatherworking
competencies.description: Crafting items from leather through cutting, tooling, and stitching

competencies.name: Candle Making
competencies.description: Creating decorative and scented candles using wax, wicks, and molds

competencies.name: Soap Making
competencies.description: Crafting handmade soaps using natural ingredients and essential oils

competencies.name: Resin Crafts
competencies.description: Creating decorative items by pouring and curing epoxy resin

competencies.name: Polymer Clay
competencies.description: Sculpting and creating items with oven-bake modeling clay

competencies.name: Pottery
competencies.description: Creating functional and decorative ceramic objects using clay and a wheel or hand-building

competencies.name: Hand-Building Pottery
competencies.description: Creating pottery without a wheel using pinch, coil, and slab techniques

competencies.name: Wheel Throwing
competencies.description: Shaping clay on a pottery wheel to create symmetrical vessels

competencies.name: Ceramic Glazing
competencies.description: Applying and firing glazes to create colorful, glass-like surfaces on pottery

prerequisites.notes: Basic pottery skills are helpful for glazing

competencies.name: Mosaic Art
competencies.description: Creating images and patterns by assembling small pieces of glass, tile, or stone

competencies.name: Stained Glass
competencies.description: Creating decorative glass panels by cutting and joining colored glass pieces

competencies.name: Glass Blowing
competencies.description: Shaping molten glass into decorative and functional objects using blowing techniques

competencies.name: Basket Weaving
competencies.description: Creating baskets by weaving natural or synthetic materials

competencies.name: Woodcarving
competencies.description: Shaping wood into decorative or functional objects using carving tools

competencies.name: Whittling
competencies.description: Carving wood into simple shapes using a knife
